scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Interest Subsidy (Fiscal Incentives to Labour Intensive Unit)
other_conditions: The industrial unit must be recognized as a Labour Intensive Unit (new unit providing a minimum of 4,000 employees registered under EPF, with at least 1,000 female employees, or an existing unit expanding/diversifying that creates at least 4,000 new jobs with at least 1,000 female employees).
The unit must have taken a sanctioned term loan for Gross Fixed Capital Investment.
The loan disbursement date must be on or after 01/01/2024 for units under implementation as of 01/10/2024.
The unit must apply within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP).
The unit must be in regular repayment of installments and interest.
The unit must bear at least 2% interest on the term loan.

Eligible activities include Garments, Apparel & Made-ups, Technical Textiles (including Composite Unit), Weaving (with or without preparatory), Knitting, Dyeing & Processing, Texturising, Twisting, Embroidery and MMF Spinning of polyester/viscose staple fiber (excluding cotton and synthetic filament yarn).
benefits_summary: Provides a credit‑linked interest subsidy of up to 7% on term loans for 8 years, with a maximum of 3% of eFCI per annum.
